anomalies.description: A dark SUV on the left side of the road abruptly swerves right and collides with a white sedan in the adjacent lane, causing visible impact and vehicle displacement.

A collision occurs: a dark sedan rapidly enters the frame from the left and impacts the recording vehicle, causing immediate camera disruption and loss of view.; Post-collision airbag deployment: the driver-side airbag is fully inflated and remains deployed for the remainder of the clip, confirming a significant impact.

A dark SUV enters the intersection from the right while the traffic light is red for it, colliding with the dashcam vehicle (which is stationary at a red light). The SUV's front right side impacts the dashcam vehicle's front left side, causing visible deformation and rotation of the SUV.
